Name: Demon Plushies (AT)
Author: MicomiBite
Description:
A trio of little demon plushies! For context, they are based on Micomi (myself), the streamer [url=https://www.twitch.tv/nyagi_byte]Nyagi_Byte[/url] (my lovely partner), and the soon-to-be streamer [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ChewyOni]ChewyOni[/url] (a close bestie). Like with the Nyagi sheep mod, I decided to release this to the public so that anyone, whether in our little communities or not, are free to enjoy them if they find these lil' plushes cute.

♡
